closest_collision.work: InfoPO: Information-Driven Policy Optimization for User-Centric Agents
closest_collision.overlap: Compares a policy's subsequent action likelihood with factual feedback versus a masked-feedback counterfactual.
closest_collision.residual_difference: InfoPO scores realized next-action tokens by teacher-forced likelihood to remove autoregressive stochastic variation and uses the score for RL credit assignment. It does not construct same-trajectory outcome-flipped reusable memories, estimate cross-feedback empirical action TV against two within-branch TV noise controls, or use that comparison to selectively add the factual SCB at inference.
